title: Claim
description: A single mathematical claim in the proof graph.

id.description: Unique identifier for this claim within the proof graph.

kind.description: The logical kind of this claim.

depends_on.description: List of claim IDs this claim depends on.

required_assurance.description: Assurance types required for this claim to be accepted.

evidence.description: Content-addressed digest references to evidence blobs.

checker_policy.description: The ID or path of the checker policy to apply to this claim.

batch_group.description: If non-empty, groups claims for batch checker invocation.

cross_domain_deps.description: Claim IDs from other domains whose attestations must be accepted first.

hypotheses.description: Explicit hypotheses of this theorem: claim IDs that must hold for this claim to be valid. Used to compute the assumption transitive closure.

cross_domain_pins.description: Structured cross-domain dependencies with optional digest pinning.

formal_backend.description: Formal proof system for this claim.

proof_term_digest.description: Content-addressed digest of the proof term or proof script.

digest.description: Content-addressed SHA256 digest of the statement text.
